name: ue57_operation_rules
description: UE Editor 操作通用规则和最佳实践。所有涉及 UE 场景修改的操作都必须遵守。 AI 在执行任何 UE 场景操作任务前应先读取此 Skill。 包含：坐标系、操作后刷新视口、Rotator 安全规则、撤销提示等强制规则。 Use when AI needs to: (1) perform any scene modification, (2) check post-operation best practices, (3) ensure viewport refresh after edits, (4) understand UE coordinate system. UE only (run_ue_python).
author: ArtClaw
